theater: 白登山與太原盆地北緣

battle.name: 白登之圍
battle.theater: 白登山與太原盆地北緣
battle.brief: 前200年冬，冒頓單于率四十萬精騎追擊漢軍，以卻月陣環圍白登山，漢軍被圍七日，天寒雪、給養不繼，士卒多餓死，陳平獻離間之計令匈奴解圍，漢軍得突圍，劉邦隨即轉向和親，漢初北疆格局定型。卡面科林斯青銅盔並非本役實物，此處作對照：匈奴控弦之士須全視野與聽覺，面甲反而要留縫以利騎射。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 白登之圍發生於漢高祖七年，即前200年冬季，戰場在今山西省大同市東北的白登山與太原盆地北緣。交戰一方是西漢朝廷：漢高祖劉邦下詔討匈奴，主力為車騎將軍灌嬰所率的騎兵十萬與步兵二十萬，另有太原守將韓王信的部眾與關中、河東調發的後續兵員；朝廷中樞由丞相陳平主持軍議，皇太后呂雉與御使大夫劉敬在決策上各有分量。另一方是匈奴單于國：冒頓單于自單于庭起兵，傾力調集控弦之士，親率大軍南下，其精騎達四十萬，左右賢王、軍臣王等部將分領各翼。匈奴並非單純的游牧散兵，而是以單于庭為中心、分層編制的部落聯盟，控弦之士平時分散於草場，臨戰依令集結。戰區第三方是樓蘭、烏孫等西域城邦與河套一線的戎夷小部，多數依附強勢一方或保持中立；韓王信在漢匈交鋒中一度降匈奴，後又歸漢，說明邊地軍將與草原之間存在隨局勢轉向的通道。本役沒有攻城器械、沒有會戰，只有一場在雪地裡發生的野戰包圍與突圍。
countriesEn: The Siege of Baideng took place in the winter of the seventh year of Emperor Gaozu of Han, that is in 200 BCE, on Baideng Mountain north-east of modern Datong in Shanxi and along the northern rim of the Taiyuan basin. One side was the court of Western Han: Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang issued the call for a campaign against the Xiongnu, and the main force was General of Chariots and Cavalry Guan Ying, with one hundred thousand horse and two hundred thousand foot; there were also the troops of Han Wang Xin who held Taiyuan, and follow-up levies sent out from Guanzhong and Hedong. At the centre of government the chancellor Chen Ping directed the war council, while the empress dowager Lü Zhi and the grand commandant Liu Jing each had a say in how policy was shaped. The other side was the Xiongnu chanyu state: Modu Chanyu mustered his archers from the chanyu tent and led the great army south himself, with four hundred thousand picked cavalry, the left and right wise kings and generals such as Junchen Wang commanding separate wings. The Xiongnu were not a loose mob of nomadic raiders but a layered tribal confederation centred on the chanyu tent, whose archers dispersed across pastures in peacetime and converged by order when war came. Third parties in the theatre were the oasis states of Loulan and Wusun in the west and the small Rong and Di peoples along the Ordos bend, most of them attached to the stronger side or staying neutral. Han Wang Xin defected to the Xiongnu during the fighting and later returned to Han, which shows that frontier commanders had channels for shifting sides as the situation changed. There were no siege engines and no pitched battle in this campaign, only a field encirclement and breakout fought in snow.
people: 冒頓單于是本役的決定人物。他在前209年前後弒殺父單于頭曼，誅弟逐妻，收攏部眾，以分食與同甘共苦整編控弦之士，馴練騎射，隨後擊破月氏、樓蘭，把匈奴帝國的勢力推向漠北與河西。面對漢朝一度鬆動的邊境經營，他選擇在漢廷內鬥、盟約失效的窗口出手，親率大軍追過長城，決心在野戰中吃掉漢軍主力。漢方主帥是車騎將軍灌嬰，他接詔率騎兵十萬、步兵二十萬北上，先在太原城下擊破匈奴一部，追擊至城下，卻因冒頓大軍迂迴至白登山而遭反包圍，陷入進退失據的處境。丞相陳平是本役的實際策劃者：白登被圍後，漢廷議戰與議和並行，陳平獻上離間之計，派使者對單于與其左右部將施以分化，又放出漢軍援兵將至的訊息，使匈奴一時不敢全師猛攻，漢軍才得以尋隙突圍。劉邦事後採納御使大夫劉敬之議轉向和親，劉敬因此封關內侯。其他關鍵人物包括：漢高祖劉邦，他在前線督戰，事後深悔，承擔了白登之敗的聲望損失；皇太后呂雉，她反對以親生女兒嫁匈奴，最終同意改以宗室女充作公主；太原守將韓王信，他奉命守太原卻被匈奴攻破，兵敗逃亡匈奴，後來被誅，連帶引發朝廷對舊功宿將的整肅；匈奴一側的軍臣王與左右賢王分統翼側騎兵，是卻月陣得以合圍的實際執行者。
peopleEn: Modu Chanyu was the decisive figure of the campaign. Around 209 BCE he killed his father, Touman Chanyu, executed his brother, drove away his wives, gathered the tribes under himself, reorganised the archers through shared rations and common hardship, and drilled them in mounted archery; he then broke the Yuezhi and the kingdom of Loulan, pushing Xiongnu power across the northern desert and into the Hexi corridor. Confronting a Han frontier that had briefly gone slack, he struck in the window opened by infighting at the Han court and by a lapsed treaty, led the great army himself across the frontier line, and resolved to destroy the Han main force in open field. The Han commander was General of Chariots and Cavalry Guan Ying, who took the field with one hundred thousand horse and two hundred thousand foot. He first beat a Xiongnu detachment below Taiyuan and pursued it to the city walls, but Modu's main body had swung round to Baideng and fell upon his rear, leaving him with no way forward or back. The chancellor Chen Ping was the real planner of the battle. After Baideng was invested, the court debated fighting and negotiating at once; Chen Ping proposed a scheme of dissension, sending emissaries to set the chanyu against his own commanders on either wing and spreading the news that Han reinforcements were on the way, so that the Xiongnu dared not press the assault with everything they had, and the Han army found a gap to break out through. Liu Bang afterwards took the advice of the grand commandant Liu Jing and turned to seeking peace, and Liu Jing was accordingly enfeoffed as marquis within the passes. Other figures who matter include Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang, who watched the fighting in person and afterwards bitterly regretted it, bearing the reputational cost of the defeat; the empress dowager Lü Zhi, who refused to give her own daughter in marriage to a Xiongnu and eventually consented only to a clan woman being sent under the title of princess; Han Wang Xin, commander at Taiyuan, whose position was overrun by the Xiongnu and who fled to their side before being executed, a case that triggered a purge of old meritorious generals at court; and on the Xiongnu side Junchen Wang and the wise kings of the left and right, who led the wings of cavalry and were the real executors of the crescent that closed the ring.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔不是前200年白登戰場上的實物。它是前650年前後希臘世界鑄造的全正面青銅盔，顏面只留窄窄的目窗與唇下的呼吸孔，戴上之後視野與聽覺都極度受限，戴者只能活在密集的重裝步兵方陣之中。實際參與白登之圍的裝備分屬兩個技術譜系。匈奴控弦之士以複合反曲角弓為主，弓身短、弓臂曲度大，配短桿重箭，箭鏃多為骨或鐵，箭桿短而便於在馬背上抽取；防護是皮甲、氈甲與骨片、銅泡拼成的頭盔，幾乎沒有金屬胸甲；靠馬匹、馬鞍與大量畜群維持一日百里以上的機動，格殺武器是骨柄短刀、彎刀與可作投擲的短矛。整套體系要求視野開闊、聽覺敏銳，與科林斯盔那種全封閉面部的取向正好相反。漢軍的裝備是秦軍體系的延續：步兵以大盾與長戟、劍結方陣，盾在前、戟矛側出，用來抵禦騎兵衝撞；騎兵同樣用弓，以楚、韓之地的弓制為主，配鐵鏃箭，格殺武器是環首刀與長矛。漢軍沒有攻城器械，本役也不需要，因為圍困發生在山道與坡地；真正決定勝負的是隨軍給養，糧食從關中、河東千里轉輸，一旦被切斷，數十萬人的隊列在雪地裡迅速崩解。科林斯青銅盔在此扮演對照物：它提醒讀者，任何一頂頭盔背後都站著一套隊形制度，制度一旦失效，再好的防具也救不了戴它的人。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card was not an artefact on the battlefield of Baideng in 200 BCE. It belongs to the full-face bronze helms of the Greek world of about 650 BCE, with only a narrow eye slit and breathing holes under the lip; once it is on, sight and hearing are severely restricted, and the wearer can only survive inside a dense phalanx of heavy infantry. The equipment actually present at Baideng belongs to two separate technical traditions. The Xiongnu archers fought with composite recurve bows, short in the stave and sharply curved, using short-shafted heavy arrows whose heads were usually bone or iron, the shafts cut short so they could be drawn from the saddle at speed. Their protection was leather, felt and helmets assembled from bone plates and bronze bosses, with almost no metal breastplate. Mobility came from horses, saddles and large herds, allowing more than a hundred li of movement in a day, and their close-combat arms were bone-handled knives, sabres and short spears that could be thrown. The whole system demanded wide vision and acute hearing, exactly opposite to the fully closed face of a Corinthian helm. The Han army continued the Qin inventory: infantry formed squares of large shields with long spears and swords, shields forward and spears to the side, to absorb cavalry charges; their horse likewise used bows, chiefly of the Chu and Han types, with iron-tipped arrows, and their close-combat arms were ring-pommel sabres and long spears. The Han had no siege engines and needed none here, since the investment took place on hillside tracks and slopes. What decided the outcome was supply: food was carried a thousand li from Guanzhong and Hedong, and once that line was cut the array of several hundred thousand men dissolved quickly in the snow. The Corinthian helmet serves in this account as a foil. It reminds the reader that behind every helmet stands a system of formation, and once that system fails, no amount of good armour saves the man wearing it.
tactics: 本役的戰術核心是匈奴的卻月陣。冒頓不急於正面硬撞漢軍方陣，而是以數十萬騎兵作半圓形展開，兩翼前伸、腹部後彎，把漢軍包在內圈。史載兩軍相距數十步，漢兵持滿待發，卻屢次衝不出缺口；匈奴也不與漢步兵正面纏鬥，只在外圈馳射放箭，用箭幕與機動力消耗漢軍體力。漢軍的處置是固守待援：步兵結大盾長戟之陣環顧四面，騎兵護在陣側，試圖以突騎撕開包圍圈的某一點，但匈奴騎兵總是讓開正面、只從側翼與背面射擊，漢軍每次突出都被迫退回。真正的崩因是天氣與後勤：時值隆冬，天降大雪，漢軍給養不繼，士卒多餓死者，陣形由密轉疏。陳平的秘計改變了局勢，他一面派人分化單于與左右賢王之間的關係，動搖其指揮一致；一面放話說漢軍援兵正從燕、齊、趙一線趕來，令單于不敢放手猛攻。匈奴圍圈因此鬆動，漢軍趁隙突出重圍，單于才發覺中計，縱精騎追擊，漢軍已收攏散卒退向關中方向。此役之後，漢廷對策從野戰反攻轉向消耗與屯糧。陳平主張轉輸河東之粟以實太原、雁門一線的守軍，劉邦聽從，並以和親換取邊境安寧。從這裡開始，漢匈對峙的樣式變成以糧固塞、以塞消耗遊牧騎兵，這是一種比白登山上的血戰漫長得多的戰爭。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the campaign was the Xiongnu crescent. Modu did not rush to smash the Han squares head on. Instead he spread tens of thousands of horsemen in a half circle, driving the wings forward and curving the belly back, so that the Han army was enclosed in the inner ring. The histories record the two armies standing a few dozen paces apart, Han soldiers holding their bows drawn, yet unable time and again to break out. The Xiongnu did not engage the Han foot in close combat either; they rode around the perimeter and loosed arrows, wearing down the Han with a curtain of missiles and with mobility. The Han answer was to hold and wait for relief: infantry stood in shield-and-spear squares facing every direction, horse covered the flanks, and attempts were made to tear open one point of the ring with a charge, but the Xiongnu always gave way in front and shot from the flank and the rear instead, and every Han sortie was driven back. The real collapse came from weather and logistics. It was deep winter, heavy snow fell, the Han ran out of food, many of the men starved, and the close order of the ranks thinned out. Chen Ping's scheme changed the situation: on one hand he sent men to set the chanyu against the wise kings on his left and right and shake the coherence of his command; on the other he let it be known that Han reinforcements were marching in from Yan, Qi and Zhao, so that the chanyu would not dare to press the attack with everything he had. The ring slackened, the Han broke out through the gap, and only then did the chanyu realise he had been played; he threw his picked cavalry after them, but the Han had already gathered their stragglers and were heading back towards Guanzhong. After this the Han court shifted from counterattack in the open field to endurance and stored grain. Chen Ping argued for shifting grain from Hedong to supply the garrisons along Taiyuan and Yanmen, Liu Bang took his advice, and peace was bought with marriage in exchange for quiet on the frontier. From that point the shape of the contest between Han and Xiongnu became: hold the passes with grain, and let the passes grind down the nomadic horse. It was a far longer war than the blood at Baideng.
data: 白登之圍留下的數字大半出自史記與漢書的追述，讀時須留一分小心。兵力量級方面，匈奴方面最常被引用的是單于所調精兵四十萬，這是兩漢文獻中匈奴最大規模的一次集中兵力記載，數字很可能含有誇大，但足以說明冒頓傾巢而出的判斷。漢軍方面，史記記灌嬰將騎兵十萬、步兵二十萬，合計約三十萬，另有韓王信部與關中、河東徵發的後續兵員，這已是漢初最大規模的一次野外部隊調動。時間方面，被圍七日是各書一致的核心數字，其後漢軍突圍與匈奴追擊又延續數日。距離上，史載兩軍相距數十步，匈奴合圍的騎兵多在漢軍矢石及之外游弋；白登山在平城東北，漢軍屯兵山上，匈奴控弦之士環列坡下，居高者正是漢軍。損耗方面沒有可靠的死亡數字，只能確定方向：史書記載士卒多餓死、給養不給、死者過半一類的概略說法，具體人數各家互有出入，不必強求精確。後勤與代價方面，和親的開銷反而是明確的：劉敬提出的方案是每年輸送絲絮、酒、米等物，並以一次性的嫁妝換取邊境安寧，匈奴因此不必以劫掠取得這些物資，漢廷則用關中的剩餘養活草原上的騎兵。斷糧在雪地裡延續約一週，數十萬人每日口糧的缺口，正是漢廷最終接受和親的直接原因。
dataEn: Most of the figures that survive for the siege come from the retrospective narrative of the Shiji and the Hanshu, and should be read with a margin of caution. On strength, the number most often cited for the Xiongnu is the four hundred thousand picked troops mustered by the chanyu. This is the largest concentration of Xiongnu force recorded anywhere in the two Han histories; the figure almost certainly carries exaggeration, but it does show the scale of Modu's decision to bring everything out. On the Han side, the Shiji records Guan Ying taking one hundred thousand horse and two hundred thousand foot, some three hundred thousand men, with the troops of Han Wang Xin and further levies from Guanzhong and Hedong on top; this was the largest field deployment the early Han had attempted. On time, seven days of encirclement is the one number all the sources agree on, followed by several more days for the breakout and the pursuit. On distance, the histories put the two armies a few dozen paces apart, with much of the encircling horse riding outside Han missile range; Baideng lay north-east of Pingcheng, the Han camped on the summit, and the Xiongnu archers were drawn up along the slopes below, so that the high ground was in Han hands. On losses there is no reliable death count, only a direction of travel: the histories speak of many soldiers starving, of supply failing, of the dead exceeding half, and the individual numbers differ from source to source and are not worth forcing into precision. On logistics and cost the accounting is actually clearer. The plan Liu Jing proposed was to send silk, felt, wine and rice every year, and to exchange a single massive dowry for peace on the frontier. The Xiongnu no longer had to raid to obtain these goods, and the Han used the surplus of Guanzhong to feed horsemen on the steppe. The breakdown of supply lasted about a week in the snow, and the daily shortfall in rations for several hundred thousand men was the direct reason the court finally accepted peace.
cause: 白登之圍的直接起因，是前200年馬邑之謀洩露之後，漢匈關係的整個框架在一年之內崩壞。漢廷原本想在馬邑設伏一舉誘捕單于，事洩之後，匈奴不但斷絕使節往來，還以韓王信降匈奴為通道攻略太原、雁門一線，直接挑戰漢室的邊防。根本的起因則是冒頓單于重建匈奴的軍事實力。他以鐵腕整頓部眾、推行騎射、合併小部，擊敗月氏與樓蘭，把勢力推展到漠北與河西，使草原聯盟在數年之內成為可與漢廷抗衡的整體。匈奴由此具備了在任何季節遠距離機動作戰的能力，能夠帶著數十萬騎兵越過塞垣，直抵漢軍側後。第三層是漢廷自身的失誤。劉邦在用人上屢屢受挫，韓王信原本是漢初名將卻被貶，後來索性降了匈奴；防守太原的任務交給韓王信，結果太原一破，匈奴得以把戰場推到漢軍側翼。同時，漢軍自垓下之戰後久未與草原騎兵大規模交手，士氣與編制都沒有為這類高速機動作戰做準備。第四層是冒頓出色的戰略耐心，他沒有選擇在邊境與漢軍逐次糾纏，而是吃掉太原、逼漢軍深入，反過來占據白登山的地形，把漢軍的糧道切斷在身後，迫使一支三十萬人的大軍在七日之內被餓潰。開戰之後，漢廷才發現真正要解決的問題不是怎樣取勝，而是怎樣活得下去。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the siege was the collapse of the whole framework of Han-Xiongnu relations within a single year, after the leak of the Mayi plot in 200 BCE. The Han had planned to ambush the chanyu at Mayi and take him in one stroke; once the scheme leaked, the Xiongnu not only broke off diplomatic contact but used Han Wang Xin's defection as a channel to strike at Taiyuan and the Yanmen line, challenging the Han frontier directly. The underlying cause was Modu's rebuilding of Xiongnu military power. With an iron hand he reorganised the tribes, pushed mounted archery, merged the smaller groups, beat the Yuezhi and Loulan, and extended his reach across the northern desert and the Hexi corridor, so that within a few years the steppe confederation became a whole power able to stand against the Han court. The Xiongnu thereby gained the capacity to move and fight at long range in any season, bringing tens of thousands of riders across the frontier line to strike the flank and the rear of a Han army. A third layer was Han error. Liu Bang had been repeatedly let down by his own appointments: Han Wang Xin, a famous general of the early Han, was demoted and eventually defected to the Xiongnu; the defence of Taiyuan was given to him, and when Taiyuan fell the Xiongnu were able to carry the war onto the flank of the Han force. At the same time, since the battle at Gaixia the Han had not faced massed steppe cavalry, and neither morale nor organisation had been prepared for warfare of this speed. A fourth layer was Modu's tactical patience. He did not choose to trade blows with the Han step by step at the frontier; he took Taiyuan, drew the Han forward, and then seized the ground at Baideng, cutting the Han supply line behind them, so that an army of three hundred thousand was starved into breaking up within seven days. Only once the fighting had begun did the Han court discover that the real problem was not how to win, but how to stay alive.
impact: 白登之圍改變了漢匈關係的基本形態。在這之前，漢廷把匈奴視為可以被一次突擊解決的邊患；此役之後，匈奴被確認為一個有總量優勢的國家，漢室的對策從主動出擊轉為長期守禦與撫綏並用。制度層面的影響最為持久。前200年冬天的和親開了漢朝對匈奴的政策先例，宗室女以公主之名出塞，邊境換取一紙盟約，其後在惠帝、呂氏秉政與文帝三朝延續不斷，到漢元帝時更演成昭君出塞的規模；與此同時，漢廷在北方設雁門、代郡等郡縣，移民實邊，加固亭障，把整個邊防從被動巡哨改成常態化的守備。軍事與財政層面，陳平輸粟河東以實邊的建議，使漢朝第一次意識到對草原騎兵作戰的真正成本是糧食運輸而非一時的勝負；漢廷此後在沿邊設屯田、修倉庾，試圖用存糧換取持久。到漢武帝時代，雪白登之恥成了對匈奴反攻的公眾口號與軍隊激勵，追擊匈奴的戰役被反覆以此為名。也就是說，白登之敗不但沒有終結漢匈戰爭，反而把它拉長，並且把它變成了漢朝整個國策問題的一部分。對匈奴本身，白登是冒頓個人威望的頂點，此後匈奴控弦之士常被說成百萬，單于的威名遠播西域，漢朝不得不承認其在漠北與河套的既成事實；邊界線向北退了數百里的同時，也給後來漢匈之間長達百餘年的拉鋸留下一個起點。
impactEn: The siege of Baideng changed the basic shape of Han-Xiongnu relations. Before it, the Han court treated the Xiongnu as a frontier trouble that a single strike might settle; after it, the Xiongnu were confirmed to be a state with an overall advantage, and the Han response turned from active attack to long-term defence combined with conciliation. The institutional consequences proved the most durable. The marriage alliance concluded in the winter of 200 BCE set a precedent for Han policy towards the Xiongnu: a woman of the imperial clan went out under the title of princess, and the frontier bought a written treaty in return. It was continued under the reigns of Hui, the Lü house and Wen, and by the time of Emperor Yuan it had grown to the scale of the Zhaojun marriage. At the same time the court established commanderies such as Yanmen and Dai in the north, moved in settlers to strengthen the border, and reinforced the beacon towers, converting the frontier defence from occasional patrols into permanent garrison duty. In military and fiscal terms, Chen Ping's proposal to shift grain from Hedong to hold the frontier taught the Han for the first time that the true cost of fighting steppe horse lay in transporting food rather than in any single day's battle; thereafter the court set up colonies and granaries along the border, trying to buy endurance with stored grain. By the reign of Emperor Wu, the shame of Baideng had become a public slogan and a spur for the great counter-offensives against the Xiongnu, whose names invoked it again and again. In other words, the defeat at Baideng did not end the Han-Xiongnu war; it lengthened it and made it part of the whole question of Han statecraft. For the Xiongnu themselves Baideng was the high point of Modu's personal prestige: the Xiongnu archer host was thereafter spoken of as a million, the chanyu's name carried far into the western regions, and the Han had to accept his accomplished fact in the northern desert and the Ordos bend. The frontier line moved back by several hundred li, and at the same time a starting point was set for the protracted contest that would run for more than a century to come.
result: 結果是漢軍慘敗而未滅。陳平之計奏效後，灌嬰部得以突圍南撤，單于發覺中計，縱精騎追擊，漢軍沿途收攏散卒，損失慘重；士卒多餓死一類的說法雖無確數，但軍紀與士氣的崩解是無可置疑的。漢廷回關中後，陳平力主轉輸河東糧食固守邊線，劉邦納其言，這是漢朝第一次把對匈奴的戰爭當作長期工程來辦。同年冬天，劉邦採納劉敬以財物易安寧的建議，遣使議和，準備以宗室女充作公主嫁與冒頓；皇太后呂雉力言不肯以親女嫁匈奴，最終仍以假公主之名成婚，並以大量絲絮、酒食、金帛作為嫁妝。單于由此一次取得漢朝多年積累的物資，漢朝則以此換來約十年的邊境安寧。國際層面的結果是雙方關係的重新定義，漢承認匈奴單于在漠北的宗主地位，約為兄弟之國，邊界線大致以秦、漢舊塞為準；匈奴則在獲得物資後背棄盟約，數度縱兵擾亂山西、河套，直到文、景之世仍無休止，使和親從一紙協議變成長期存在的邊患形式。從長時間看，白登之圍的真正遺產有三項：漢朝對匈奴由攻轉守的國策轉向、以糧食對抗騎兵的邊防模式，以及一段延續數百年的和親制度。冒頓單于在位期間把匈奴推向極盛，隨即在數年內去世，漢朝則在屈辱中積累國力，終於在百餘年後由漢武帝發動大規模反攻。前200年那個冬天，漢朝在白登山下失去了對北疆的主動權，而這份記憶在往後兩千年裡始終沒有消失。
resultEn: The outcome was a crushing Han defeat that was not an annihilation. Once Chen Ping's scheme took effect, Guan Ying's command was able to break out and withdraw south; the chanyu realised he had been played and threw his picked cavalry after them, and the Han gathered their stragglers on the way back at a heavy cost. Descriptions of many soldiers starving away lack a firm count, but the collapse of discipline and morale is beyond dispute. Back in Guanzhong, Chen Ping pressed for grain to be shifted from Hedong to hold the frontier line, and Liu Bang accepted; this was the first time the Han had treated the war against the Xiongnu as a long-term engineering problem. In the same winter Liu Bang took Liu Jing's advice to exchange goods for peace and sent emissaries to negotiate a match, intending to send a woman of the imperial clan as a princess to Modu. Lü Zhi protested strongly against giving her own daughter to a Xiongnu, and in the end the marriage went ahead under the name of a false princess, with a large dowry of silk, felt, wine, rice and gold and silver. The chanyu thus obtained in one stroke goods that the Han had taken years to accumulate, and the Han bought roughly a decade of quiet on the frontier. At the level of interstate relations the result was a redefinition between the two sides: Han recognised the chanyu's overlordship in the northern desert, the two called themselves brothers, and the boundary ran roughly along the old Qin and Han lines of forts. The Xiongnu, having taken delivery of the goods, broke the treaty and repeatedly raided Shanxi and the Ordos region, without respite even under the emperors Wen and Jing, so that seeking peace became in practice a long-standing form of frontier trouble rather than a single agreement. In the long run the true legacy of Baideng was threefold: the turn of Han statecraft from attack to defence towards the Xiongnu, a frontier model based on using food to hold off horse, and a system of marriage alliances that ran for centuries. Modu pushed the Xiongnu to their height during his reign and died only a few years later, while the Han, gathering strength through humiliation, at last launched a large-scale counter-offensive more than a century later under Emperor Wu. In that winter of 200 BCE the Han lost the initiative in the northern frontier at the foot of Baideng, and the memory of it never faded over the two thousand years that followed.
